description: System invariants governing runtime scripts, control plane commands, and verification harnesses.

invariants.name: Canonical GDDP Control Plane
invariants.quoted_invariant: gddp is the canonical control plane for operators and agents. Job and queue operations route through gddp jobs (gddp jobs list, gddp jobs show <ref>, gddp jobs set <ref> <state> --reason "...", gddp jobs retry <ref> --reason "..."). The runtime backend (scripts/jobs_status.py) updates queue records under gddp jobs authority, while graph truth remains strictly human-governed.
invariants.rule: Execute job and queue operations exclusively through gddp jobs commands, treating backend scripts as underlying implementation detail.
invariants.drift_pattern: Instructing operators to invoke scripts/jobs_status.py directly or writing ad-hoc python scripts to manipulate database rows.

invariants.name: Evaluation Precedes Admission Control
invariants.quoted_invariant: No admission gate, verification mechanism, policy layer, intermediate check, or other governance mechanism may suppress or preempt evaluation. Such mechanisms may produce evidence for the evaluator and may govern subsequent acceptance or merge, but they may not substitute for, prevent, or terminate the evaluator's judgment.
invariants.rule: Allow the evaluator to examine evidence and formulate verdicts across all completed attempts regardless of intermediate check results.
invariants.drift_pattern: Terminating or short-circuiting the evaluation pipeline early because an intermediate script or gate check reported issues.

invariants.name: Frozen Infrastructure Discipline
invariants.quoted_invariant: Components marked as frozen (scripts/intake_server.py, scripts/adapters/jules_*, deploy/rig1-heartbeat/, deploy/deploy.sh, scripts/rollback.py, scripts/export_evaluations.py) receive zero speculative investment and may only be modified when explicitly targeted by a named node.
invariants.rule: Maintain frozen surfaces without modification unless an approved node explicitly targets them.
invariants.drift_pattern: Refactoring scripts/intake_server.py or legacy adapters during unrelated tasks.

invariants.name: Tests Can Fail, Nodes Can Pass
invariants.quoted_invariant: node status reflects accepted graph progress, not temporary implementation perfection. Tests are evidence, not graph truth. Criteria are evidence, not graph truth. Evaluator verdicts are evidence, not graph truth. Only human-accepted node status is graph truth.
invariants.rule: Treat test suites as implementation evidence while evaluating overall node satisfaction against project intent.
invariants.drift_pattern: Rejecting a node outright or assuming graph failure solely because an ancillary test failed.

invariants.name: Verify Before Building Architecture
invariants.quoted_invariant: 1. An agent assumes that a certain behavior exists. 2. That agent designs around that assumption without verifying. 3. The system fails because the assumption was false. 4. More machinery is proposed to fix the failure and that invented workaround becomes architecture. None of the architecture or implementation is considered sacred or unchallengeable.
invariants.rule: Verify runtime behavior and system state with live tests and empirical inspection prior to formulating architectural proposals.
invariants.drift_pattern: Assuming system behavior, encountering failure, and creating complex workarounds around unverified assumptions.
